lines.text: After Jesus came down from the mountain, He touched a leper, cleansed him, and told him to show himself to the priest.
In Capernaum a centurion pleaded for his paralyzed servant, saying he was not worthy to have Jesus come under his roof.
Jesus marveled at the centurion's faith and said many would share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob from the north and south.
Jesus told the centurion to go, and his servant was healed; then Jesus touched the hand of Peter's mother-in-law, and her fever left.
That evening Jesus drove out spirits with a word and healed all the sick, fulfilling what the prophet Moses spoke.
